thread:
maria_support: FYI — AcmeGames reported streaming replies cutting off after a long idle (≈75s). Final event often truncated; client reconnects and sees duplicate partial output. They use ALB in front + Cloudflare. @devon_infra can you triage?

devon_infra: Got it. Do you have request_ids / traces? Is this HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1? Any nat/edge in front? Also which client/browser?

maria_support: Request IDs: rq_2026-03-12-T2:772ef2a1, rq_2026-03-12-T2:772ef2b9. Customer uses web app (Safari 16 on macOS). Route: /v1/stream/chat (chunked SSE). Headers they see: Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Connection: keep-alive. They say last chunk looks like partial JSON: "{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Thanks, he"" then EOF.

nathan_sre: Can you paste the server-side tail of logs around the trace? Also ALB idle timeout default is 60s — could be half-close problem with ALB/Cloudflare. We saw similar with ALB + Cloudflare where ALB half-closes and proxy buffers a little then flushes.

devon_infra: Sample tcpdump around FIN from origin -> ALB:
```
12:14:45.123456 IP origin.443 > alb.52344: Flags [P.], seq 3456:3890, ack 2211, win 64240, length 434
12:15:00.987654 IP alb.52344 > client.51234: Flags [F.], seq 2211, ack 3890, win 65535, length 0
```
So FIN sent by ALB shortly after a quiet period. Suggests ALB closed underlying connection while origin still had KV cache and chunk stream open.

cloudflare-bot: Note: Cloudflare sometimes aggregates small chunks if origin TCP keepalive doesn't match CF's idle timeout. Check "Origin keepalive" and HTTP/2 settings. Also: header X-Accel-Buffering: no recommended.

devon_infra: Repro command we used locally (mimics client):
```
curl -N -v --http2 https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -d @prompt.json
```
With --no-buffer we saw same truncation after ~75s idle. When we put a periodic 1-byte heartbeat from server every 20s, stream remained healthy.

maria_support: Customer sent explicit repro steps: send stream, leave idle ~75s, then server replies final event and immediately connection terminates; client gets EOF mid-json. They can't change Cloudflare settings.

nathan_sre: Proposal: short-term mitigations:
- Add server heartbeats every 20s (SSE comment line ":\n").
- On the infra side, increase ALB idle timeout for that target group to 300s for affected customers.
- Set nginx/envoy to disable response buffering for SSE routes: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_cache off;`

devon_infra: Long term: we should implement server-side chunk flush (send small keepalive bytes) as default for SSE routes and detect half-close (FIN from LB) to gracefully finish JSON before close. Also consider adding a tenant routing rule to avoid CF when can't change CF config.

maria_support: Customer can't change CF, asking for ETA. Can we quick-fix with server heartbeat patch? What's required?

devon_infra: I'll open a hotfix PR to add heartbeat bytes into streaming pipeline and add config flag to toggle per-tenant. ETA: 2 business days to review + deploy to staging. @nathan_sre can you update infra ticket to increase ALB idle timeout for AcmeGames target group once PR is deployed?

nathan_sre: Yep, will create infra change request and run canary (impact: low). I'll also add a one-off rule to disable keepalive aggregation for that target. Tracking: INC-2026-0312-01. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Thanks — please post updates here and I'll notify customer when we have staging repro + production rollout plan. :pray:

customer_bob: Thanks team, appreciate the quick triage. We'll await the heartbeat rollout. If you need access to our CF account for testing, ping me.
